claims.text: No medication is FDA-approved for cocaine use disorder;
claims.quote: No medications have been approved by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration for the treatment of cocaine use disorder.

claims.text: a Cochrane review found low-level evidence for disulfiram added to psychosocial therapy,
claims.quote: concluded that there is low-level evidence to support the use of disulfiram (Antabuse) in addition to psychosocial therapy for treatment of cocaine use disorder

claims.text: and no evidence for anticonvulsants, dopamine agonists, antipsychotics or antidepressants.
